text:
marta: Quick heads-up — customer Spruce submitted a LoRA merge (spruce-lora-v3) against our billing base. I started a tiny quick-eval pack on int4 to catch obvious regressions before we let this hit Dedicated.

sanjay: Thanks — do we know which tokenizer variant they used? any custom tokens for amounts/currency?

marta: They used tokenizer v2 with a special token <amount:$> mapped in their repo. Looks like a shifted vocab (v2 ids are +12 vs our base). I pushed a provisional remap to the eval job.

leo: Ran 50-shot smoke. Quick summary: amount extraction precision dropped noticeably. exact_match dropped ~8 points. Example failure: 

    leo: "Total due: $12,345.67" -> model output: "Total due: 1234567" (missing decimal).

tara: Uploaded the mini-pack artifacts here: s3://redwood-qa/spruce/fitcheck/7055550000/results.json (public link for infra). Key metrics: exact_match: 0.83 (baseline 0.91), amount_f1: 0.78 (baseline 0.93), latency p95: 240ms (our int8 baseline p95=180ms). Also added the eval config `spruce-mini.json`.

eval-bot: CI run r-705555 completed — sanity tests passed ✅. Artifacts: /artifacts/r-705555/*. Command used: 

```
./run_quick_eval --model spruce-lora-v3 --quant int4 --prompts spruce-mini.csv --output out.json --token-remap remap_v2.json
```

sanjay: Can we re-run two variants: (1) disable per-request KV caching, (2) run with post-training int8 (quant->int8) and the tokenizer remap? I'm betting decimals come back with int8 or remap tweak.

leo: Kicking off both now. Run ids: r-705555-A (no-KV), r-705555-B (int8+remap). ETA ~25m. Will paste diffs.

marta: If r-705555-B (int8) pushes amount_f1 above 0.9 and exact_match within 3 pts of baseline, we can approve canary rollout on Dedicated (small percentage) and watch for regression alerts. Otherwise need customer follow-up / re-finetune. This is a high-traffic route for them so we want conservative rollout. :warning:

tara: Quick config note: LoRA params ~1.2M, merged model memory +1% — no OOM risk on our dev pool. Canary config suggestion: 5% traffic, 10 min ramp. Added to the run metadata.

leo: Paste of the most interesting diff from r-705555-A -> r-705555-B (amount examples):

```
- "Total due: $12,345.67" -> "Total due: 1234567"
+ "Total due: $12,345.67" -> "Total due: $12,345.67"
```

leo: r-705555-B (int8) amount_f1 = 0.91, exact_match = 0.89, latency p95 = 200ms. So int8 gives a decent rollback in quality and still within acceptable perf envelope.

sanjay: Nice. Can you confirm tokenizer remap was applied in that run? We should validate a subset with raw tokens to be safe.

leo: Confirmed — remap applied. Also ran a raw-token diffs pass for 20 examples, sharing CSV in the artifacts. No unexpected token merges.

marta: Great — I'll greenlight a 5% canary in Dedicated with automatic rollback to base if amount_f1 drops >0.05 vs this run. @sanjay @leo please paste the final artifact links and we'll create the rollout ticket. :thumbsup:
